**BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn** is a specialized psychiatric department for toddlers operating within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and functioning as an organizational unit under [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src5] [^src6]. The clinic reports its clinical data to the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], contributing to the national monitoring and quality assurance of ADHD diagnostic practices in Denmark [^src4]. 

The clinic plays a dominant role in the regional data for toddler psychiatry. For quality [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]], which measures the proportion of ADHD diagnostic processes for children aged 0–5 that include a clinical environmental observation within 120 days, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn reports numbers that are identical to the aggregate data for the entirety of Region Midtjylland [^src1]. This indicates that the clinic effectively represents the region's entire focus and capacity for this specific age group and indicator [^src1]. Furthermore, the clinic successfully achieves the target for Indikator 2a, recording an 86% fulfillment rate (with a 95% confidence interval of 74–94%) in the 2024 report [^src3].

Beyond toddler-specific metrics, the clinic is also evaluated on indicators for older children and general treatment practices. For [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]], which assesses diagnostic processes for 6–17-year-olds, the clinic achieved a 94% fulfillment rate in one reporting period [^src3], and a 75% target fulfillment (95% CI: 66–83) in the 2023/24 period [^src6]. Additionally, the clinic demonstrated a psychoeducation rate of 81% for [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] [^src4]. In the reporting period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, the clinic registered 38 disproved (ruled out) diagnostic processes [^src5]. Overall, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn is highlighted in national reports as a positive example that consistently meets or approaches the development targets for ADHD diagnostics, standing in contrast to regions and departments struggling with capacity and implementation [^src3].
